FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Paws & Claws Veterinary Services, we provide comprehensive animal care focused primarily on routine medical services, diagnostics, and minor surgical procedures for companion animals. Our operations are centered around our state-of-the-art facility, where we maintain strict compliance with local animal welfare standards. Our team of licensed veterinarians and credentialed veterinary technicians ensures that all medical procedures are carried out safely and effectively. We also have established waste handling protocols for biohazardous materials, which help prevent health risks. Additionally, we emphasize animal containment and employ secure practices to guarantee the safety of all animals in our care. We do not engage in large-scale boarding operations; any limited boarding services offered are secondary and adhere to all relevant welfare standards, ensuring a high-quality experience for both pets and their owners.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Paws & Claws Veterinary Services is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing veterinary care and related services for companion animals.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Paws & Claws Veterinary Services does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is solely on providing veterinary care and related services for companion animals.

FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Paws & Claws Veterinary Services does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals outside of standard veterinary practices, and all materials are managed following established safety protocols.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Paws & Claws Veterinary Services does not have any catastrophe exposure, as we focus on routine medical services for companion animals and do not engage in high-risk operations.
